what_it_is: TX LO leakage per run (level re the data rms) and the precise per-run CFO, from analysis_scripts/remeasure_lo_leakage.py. The tone sits at the CFO plus a fleet-constant offset per band. The old radio_characterise reading searched +-5 Hz around the x^4 CFO, which is biased by about -7 ppb (-3 / -6.5 / -15..-18 Hz at 433 / 915 / 2400), so it missed the tone at 915 and 2400 (25-30 dB low at 2400) and made the level look bimodal.
level_model: fitted per session by the generator (robust Gaussian, or a two-component mixture where BIC clearly prefers one). One state at gain 77 (within-session sd ~0.6 dB, sessions agree to ~0.3 dB); at gain 89 some sessions show two states 10-17 dB apart that runs switch between at random (10/46 sessions at 433, 3/45 at 915, 0 at 2400).
null_runs: leak_dbc null = tone not found at the band offset and > 10 dB below the session median (a missed tone, not a level); excluded from the level pool
note: July training sessions only (generalisation_work/july_sessions.json); band offsets from these runs
